name: Docker Sandboxes (sbx)
description: OpenClaw sandbox backend that runs agent exec and file tools inside Docker Sandboxes (sbx) microVMs, each with its own kernel and Docker engine.

command.label: sbx command
command.help: Path or name of the sbx CLI.

agent.label: Agent or kit
agent.help: sbx agent name or kit reference used at create time. "shell" is a plain exec sandbox.

cpus.label: CPUs
cpus.help: CPUs per sandbox (--cpus). Default: sbx decides.

staticMcp.label: Static MCP servers
staticMcp.help: sbx MCP gateway server names fixed at create time (--static-mcp).

timeoutSeconds.label: Command timeout (s)
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for sbx management calls such as create.
